title: SETS — shared checklist

release.web: The served build still contains the earlier opt-in V2 beta. Both newer progression candidates remain blocked by one repeated-target defect. Four other repair groups and preservation of newer production changes pass the bounded review; neither candidate is the served app.
release.backend: Development testing is available under the existing model. Verify the connection and test-account separation; installed deletion and retention behavior still needs checking.
release.next: Repair the remaining progression target rule and preserve the accepted fixes and original checks. Then complete final app, phone and real-service acceptance before release. Quiet automatic recovery retains its 14 controlled physical-iPhone and compiled-browser passes; current-production integration and real-service verification remain pending. The separate database reset risk and GEN-28 integration remain open.

notes: Latest progression review: 6 September 2026. Other task evidence retains its own date. There are 88 current tasks and 123 archived records; these are work items, not a completion percentage or a count of confirmed bugs.
All 146 original IDs are retained. Stale reminders and duplicates are archived; missing findings and the seven individual watch checks have been added.
Known issue means the stated source or candidate defect has evidence. Needs checking also includes unreleased repairs and unconfirmed reports; read each summary for the distinction.
Local tests, a pushed branch, integration, deployment and real-device acceptance are separate. Earlier sign-offs have not all been rerun in this review.
Existing assignments are unchanged, including all 14 Josh assignments. Unassigned means no implementation owner has been chosen. Historical author credits do not assign new work.

Local reproductions, candidate preparation and code review can proceed independently. Shared account/sync contracts and installed service configuration must be coordinated before integration or release.
This update publishes checklist summaries only. It does not change the SETS app, PowerSync, task schedules or release permissions.

changes.text: Recorded the final bounded progression review. Four repair groups, newer production preservation and restored original acceptance checks pass; one repeated-target defect remains in two continuation cases. Updated eight existing records with solutions and candidate-only status. All IDs and assignments are preserved. No app release or PowerSync change.

Recorded the final progression re-review: both newer candidates remain blocked. Original repair cases now pass, including the withdrawn rep ceiling, but five interaction groups, approval-check deviations and missing production changes remain. Updated the two affected records with concrete repair steps. No app source, release or ownership change.

Confirmed all 14 physical-iPhone checks for the exact quiet-recovery build: automatic retry without another action, exact values and history preserved, no duplicate completion, safe recovery and upload ordering. Four related records updated. Real-service verification and app integration remain pending; no app release or PowerSync change. All IDs and assignments remain unchanged.

Recorded the earlier repair build passing all 12 physical-iPhone checks. Updated four data-protection records for the founder-requested quiet automatic recovery: 482 logger/recovery tests, 61 sync tests and 14 compiled browser cases pass. New successor phone and real-service checks remain pending. All task IDs and assignments are unchanged; no app release or PowerSync change.

Resolved the progression ceiling-rule conflict using the existing dated founder instructions. It is now an implementation repair, not another decision for Aadam. The repair plan preserves newer stalled-lifter fixes, weight-rounding rules and existing approval checks. Eight repairs remain before default rollout; no app repair or release is claimed by this update.

Recorded the completed V2 beta adversarial review: seven implementation gaps and one rule/test conflict block default rollout. Reused existing tasks, added three distinct defects, removed stale blanket coverage claims and supplied a repair for each. Selected engine failures reproduce in the served bundle; full phone behavior remains unverified. This publishes checklist status only.

Implemented and independently reviewed the four data-protection repairs locally. The final full suite passes 7,906 tests with the same two skips; the built browser test passes 11 scenarios, preserving the earlier fixes. New phone and service acceptance remain pending. Added the separate legacy database reset risk and its solution. GEN-28 Round 4 is reviewed locally and its owner reports the full automated check passing; app integration remains pending. No app release or PowerSync/model change.

Astra Ultra adversarial review holds the local data-protection batch: one new upload-wait regression, an unresolved-failure sync gap, completed-set edit false saving, and a draft recovery limitation. Paired tests distinguish the new regression from existing behavior. Each task now includes its solution. Earlier phone passes remain valid for their narrower inputs; no app code was changed or released during review.

The repaired test build now passes all three controlled checks on the physical iPhone, including storage-full truthfulness and save-once retry after reopening. The repeated failure came from the older build; old test links now open the repaired build. App integration/release and real cloud/PowerSync checks remain separate.

Implemented and reviewed the failed-save logger repair locally. Seven new failure/retry cases pass, the full suite passes, and the updated compiled browser test preserves history, avoids false completion and saves the retry exactly once. Repaired-build phone acceptance is pending. No app release or PowerSync model change.

Physical iPhone results received: controlled delayed-upload and retry checks passed; all synthetic old history survived full storage. The phone also reproduced the unsaved-set completion bug. Release remains held; these local test-backend results do not establish real cloud or PowerSync acceptance.

Added the supplied progression/logger review: all 17 findings are mapped, related findings are grouped, and overlaps are attached to existing tasks. Eighteen new lead-owned checks also capture the open questions and audit follow-ups. These reports await lead verification; no app fix, new test pass or release is claimed.

Compiled test build prepared. Controlled delayed-upload and retry checks passed; old history survived full storage. Reopened the set-completion bug: the logger can show success after a failed save. Release is on hold. Clarified that Sync Now still does not await PowerSync’s separate queue; phone/cloud acceptance remains open.

Recorded local storage-history and Sync Now fixes with focused tests and peer review, plus the GEN-28 Round 3 final report. These are candidates awaiting app acceptance and release. Account ownership remains open; existing assignees are preserved.

Recorded GEN-28 Round 3 as in progress. The confirmed powerbuilding rep policy supersedes the earlier documentation conflict; strict checker validation, automated coverage and integration acceptance remain open.

Clarified that the released Progression Engine V2 is already available in the live app as an opt-in setting. The latest additional V2 fixes remain unreleased. Replaced ambiguous copy terminology with app wording updates.

Clarified that the existing Development instance is available for coordinated testing under its current data model. Removed the unresolved ownership/permission blocker; connection and test-data separation checks remain.

Reconciled production and candidate evidence; added missing findings, split the watch list, archived stale reminders and duplicates, reopened the default rep-range issue, and confirmed remaining GEN-28 prescription and checker defects with its agent. Existing assignments are preserved.
Published the shared SETS checklist with all 146 task records, prominent assignee badges and search/status/area/owner filters.
Kept Josh’s 14 assignments unchanged and moved 14 former Grok/Claude assignments to Codex.
Recorded that the staging implementation already exists. Its isolated sync connection and release gates remain open.
